mapper.sql: p.pid,p.uid,p.wtitle,COALESCE(p.wdesc,'') AS wdesc,p.vurl, COALESCE(p.viewcount,0) AS viewcount,COALESCE(p.votecount,0) AS votecount,p.wstatus, DATE_FORMAT(p.cwtime,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS cwtime, COALESCE(p.likep,0) AS likep,u.uname,u.avatar,p.pcid,c.pcname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liketable l WHERE l.targetid=p.pid AND l.targettype='帖子') AS realLikeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite fa WHERE fa.pid = p.pid) AS favoriteCount

choose.when: p.uid=#{uid} AND p.wstatus IN ('展示','待审核','隐藏','已驳回') AND p.wstatus=#{status}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pwork p WHERE

SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.pcid ORDER BY (COALESCE(p.likep,0)*2 + COALESCE(p.votecount,0)*5 + COALESCE(p.viewcount,0)/10.0) / SQRT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p.cwtime, NOW()) + 1) DESC, p.pid ASC ) AS rn FROM pwork p LEFT JOIN user u ON u.uid=p.uid LEFT JOIN pclist c ON c.pcid=p.pcid WHERE ) ranked ORDER BY ranked.rn ASC, ranked.pcid ASC
SELECT
,(SELECT CASE WHEN a.act='reject' THEN a.reason ELSE NULL END FROM waudit a WHERE a.pid=p.pid ORDER BY a.ct DESC,a.aid DESC LIMIT 1) AS reason
FROM pwork p LEFT JOIN user u ON u.uid=p.uid LEFT JOIN pclist c ON c.pcid=p.pcid
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT pcid, SUM(c) AS c, SUM(SUM(c)) OVER () AS total FROM ( SELECT p2.pcid AS pcid, COUNT(*) AS c FROM liketable l2 JOIN pwork p2 ON p2.pid = l2.targetid WHERE l2.uid = #{viewerUid} AND l2.targettype = '帖子' GROUP BY p2.pcid UNION ALL SELECT p2.pcid AS pcid, COUNT(*) AS c FROM favorite f2 JOIN pwork p2 ON p2.pid = f2.pid WHERE f2.uid = #{viewerUid} GROUP BY p2.pcid ) parts GROUP BY pcid ) uf ON uf.pcid = p.pcid
WHERE
ORDER BY ((COALESCE(p.likep,0)*2 + COALESCE(p.votecount,0)*5 + COALESCE(p.viewcount,0)/10.0) / SQRT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p.cwtime, NOW()) + 1)) * (1 + COALESCE(2 * COALESCE(uf.c, 0) / NULLIF(uf.total, 0), 0)) DESC, p.pid ASC
ORDER BY (COALESCE(p.likep,0)+COALESCE(p.votecount,0)) DESC,p.pid ASC ORDER BY p.cwtime DESC,p.pid ASC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM pwork p LEFT JOIN user u ON u.uid=p.uid LEFT JOIN pclist c ON c.pcid=p.pcid WHERE p.pid=#{pid} AND (p.wstatus='展示' OR p.uid=#{viewerUid})
mapper.update: UPDATE pwork SET viewcount=COALESCE(viewcount,0)+1 WHERE pid=#{pid} AND (wstatus='展示' OR uid=#{viewerUid})
mapper.select: SELECT openid FROM user WHERE uid=#{uid}
